text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77.7k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outperforming with a 5.3% jump, suggesting rotation into altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominant market share at 58.2%. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 56 but has cooled 18 points over the week, indicating sentiment peaked recently and traders are taking a more cautious stance. Total volume at $107B remains solid, reflecting active participation without panic or euphoria.
